inspection.title: Where Royal Heritage Becomes Your Forever
inspection.subtitle: Celebrate your union on the tranquil banks of the River Betwa, across from Orchha's 16th-century royal horizon. Sprawling illuminated banquet lawns, canopied mandaps, and authentic Bundelkhand hospitality tailored for unforgettable memories.
